devilAngelTransformationRules.locked2026-09-21: Structure: CHAOS OPEN (bill argument, full devil) -> cut back -> FLAG 1 table (tiny horns, then new table + subtle halo) -> FLAG 2 glass/utensils (horns + tail, replaced, sweet again, brief halo) -> FLAG 3 the bill (full devil: horns, tail, pitchfork; NO narration over the peak; waitress leaves, she turns to camera with sweet smile and clear halo) -> REALIZATION montage -> early-morning drop-off ending.
devilAngelTransformationRules.supersededBy2026-09-22: Simpler locked order used in the actual delivered episode: devil water -> angel water -> devil table -> angel table -> bill devil (extended) -> full-body-red-tail escalation -> bill angel -> flirt ending. The full early-morning-dropoff ending was NOT used; the episode ends on the bill resolution + flirt beat instead.
devilAngelTransformationRules.severityLadder: Escalation gets stronger each time: ~25% at water (tiny horns, eye flash), ~60% at table/glass (bigger horns, redder skin, steam, beginning tail), 100% at the bill (full transformation: deep crimson skin, full horns, lava eyes, tail, restrained heat effect).
devilAngelTransformationRules.resetRule: Every reset is an INSTANT HARD CUT, never a slow morph — devil to perfectly pleasant in one frame, halo growing more obvious on each reset. Escalation is shown in stages over several seconds; the reset is always faster than the escalation.
devilAngelTransformationRules.chainingTechnique: Exact-last-frame chaining between clips that continue the same action (ffmpeg -sseof extraction -> Higgsfield media_upload -> next clip's start_image). Never reuse a shared 'target' still as both a clip's end and the next clip's start — this exact bug caused a visible transition mismatch, root-caused and fixed mid-production.
devilAngelTransformationRules.vTagRule: Only documented ElevenLabs v3 tags: [whispers] [sighs] [laughs] [sarcastic] [curious] [excited], plus proven-working [thoughtful] [surprised] [short pause] [long pause] [chuckles]. Never invented tags.
